Crack/Rust/Spalling confirmed visually (vertical crack top-right; small rust-colored mark; multiple small spall pits plus a larger flaked patch). Checked the polygons against the red spray-painted graffiti/circles on this wall per README item 2: the Spalling polygons trace genuine small pits, not the graffiti lines - geometry accepted. Rockpocket instance marks only a single ambiguous dark speck on otherwise ordinary concrete texture with no visible aggregate-exposure/void pattern (taxonomy explicitly excludes "ordinary texture"); downgraded crack-adjacent Rockpocket label to unknown_review per README item 6 (reviewer terminology confirmation required), rather than dropping it, per the "never convert unknown to negative" rule. Note for project owner: native annotation also contains 9 additional shapes under 5 labels not in TAXONOMY.md source-mapping scope for this packet (Cavity x3, Hollowareas x2, Wetspot x2, Weathering x1, WConccor x1) which are absent from normalized_annotations; WConccor specifically should map to unknown_review per the taxonomy table rather than being silently dropped - worth a pipeline check. Also corrected an invalid placeholder geometry_decision value ("automated_geometry_qc_passed") from the source file, which is not one of the three allowed values (accept/relabel/reject).
